description: This file defines the 'ParticleSystemDestroyer' class which manages the lifecycle of particle systems in a Unity project, including timing their destruction after a random duration and providing a method to prematurely stop the effect.

classes.name: ParticleSystemDestroyer
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour component that manages the timing and destruction of particle systems, including stopping emission early and waiting for particles to expire before destroying the game object.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the particle systems, calculates the maximum lifetime, waits for a random duration, then disables emission and destroys the game object after particles expire.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Method to prematurely stop the particle system by setting a flag that causes the waiting loop to exit early.
